Compositor.description: The compositor Raffi runs in, for window switching, launching and log out.

OneOrMany.description: A single value, or a list of them.

OneOrMany2.description: A single value, or a list of them.

RaffiConfig.description: Represents the configuration for each Raffi entry.

alias.description:
Route this launcher to an internal command: picking it types this text
for you, such as `mp linus/linux` (an addon keyword
followed by its query). Cannot be combined with `binary`, `script` or
`args`.

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after launching this entry (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

ifcompositor.description:
Show the entry only inside this compositor, or one of these:
`hyprland`, `niri`, `sway`.

keyword.description:
Keyword that stands for `alias` while typing: with keyword `linoux`,
typing `linoux torvalds` searches `mp linus/linux torvalds`
while the input keeps showing `linoux torvalds`. Requires `alias`; no
whitespace.

raise.description:
Focus the app's open window instead of starting it again
(default: `general.raise_running`, else false).

show_preview.description: Show the right-hand preview pane when this launcher entry is selected (default: false).

window_class.description:
Window class (Hyprland, Xwayland) or app ID (niri, sway) of the app's
windows, for `raise` (default: the binary name).
